name: Lyo.ChangeTracker
tagline: Generic entity change history built around `Lyo.EntityReference.Models.EntityRef`. Record property-level changes for any entity type without coupling the tracker to a specific aggregate.
description: Generic entity change history built around `Lyo.EntityReference.Models.EntityRef`. Record property-level changes for any entity type without coupling the tracker to a specific aggregate.
features: `ChangeRecord` for entity-scoped history with old values, changed values, optional actor (`FromEntity` at API; `from_entity_*` in DB), and optional `ChangeType` / `Message`
`IChangeTracker` for recording, querying, and deleting change history
`NullChangeTracker.Instance` (singleton) when change tracking is optional. All writes and queries are no-ops.

examples.title: Quick start

sections.title: `IChangeTracker` methods
rows: Record many records in a single batch (skips empty collections).
Look up a recorded change by its `ChangeRecord.Id`.
Returns history for a specific entity, newest first.
Returns history scoped by entity type, optionally filtered by id.
Deletes all history rows recorded against a specific entity.
sections.trail: The base abstraction is a contract only. Health and diagnostics come from adapter packages. See `Lyo.ChangeTracker.Postgres`.
